scripts.build: nuxt build && node scripts/strip-leaked-paths.mjs && node scripts/inline-critical-css.mjs

//overrides.esbuild: pinned ahead of the transitive range
//overrides.sharp: @nuxt/image@1.x declares ipx@^2.1.1 as an optionalDependency, and ipx@2.1.1 pins sharp@^0.32.6 — vulnerable libvips (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). The upstream fix is @nuxt/image@2, which requires @nuxt/kit@4 (i.e. a Nuxt 3 -> 4 migration). Forcing sharp>=0.35 clears the advisory while staying on Nuxt 3: ipx only calls long-stable sharp APIs (resize/rotate/extract/extend/toFormat/toBuffer). Remove this override when migrating to Nuxt 4 + @nuxt/image@2.
